title: Epi part of compatible finite-etale Hom descent
statement: A morphism whose restrictions to every finite-etale splitting chart are epic is epic.

proof.text: Apply the local-surjectivity component of the descent argument to obtain Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f.hom from the chartwise epimorphism hypotheses and hf.
The sheaf criterion turns local surjectivity into Epi f.hom, and the forgetful functor from internal modules reflects epimorphisms, yielding Epi f.

from.place: Existence and epi-cancellation parts of the descent proof

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleSplitHom_epi
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite p] [Etale p]
    (Q P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (f : Q ⟶ P)
    (d : ∀ c : FiniteEtaleModuleChart p,
      (upperStar Λ c.map).obj Q ⟶ (upperStar Λ c.map).obj P)
    (hf : ∀ c, (upperStar Λ c.map).map f = d c)
    (hd : ∀ c, Epi (d c)) : Epi f
